subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: Adds a favorite counter to any extendable resource: a signed-in user adds the resource to his favorites or removes it.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: The rendering is the database template extend_favorite (core templates). Its forms post to jsp/site/Portal.jsp?page=extendfavorite&action=doFavorite or action=doCancelFavorite with the fields idExtendableResource, extendableResourceType, favoriteValue (add only) and _csrftoken, whose value is ${favoriteToken} or ${cancelFavoriteToken}.

Version 2.0.0 removes DoFavorite.jsp and DoCancelFavorite.jsp: the upgrade rewrites any extend_favorite template still linking to them with the default one. A site that customised this template ports its customisation to the forms above.
